name: ForkLift
price: Paid lifetime license with 1 or 2 years of updates: $19.95 / $34.95 single user, $29.95 / $49.95 family, $69.95 / $119.95 small business (5 Macs); free trial; also on Setapp
engine: macOS Quick Look / AVFoundation (preview pane only)
summary: Dual-pane file manager and file transfer client for macOS. Strong at remote connections (SFTP, S3, cloud drives), folder sync, multi-rename and keyboard-driven file work, with a preview pane for images, audio, video and PDFs.
where_it_wins: Remote and cloud connections (SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, S3, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox)
Git status, tags, workspaces, app deleter
Full file manager: undo, conflict handling, transfer queue
where_schnellbild_wins: Real image and video viewer: full-size view, slideshow, MKV/AVI/WebM via built-in VLC
Photo and video thumbnails with folder previews tuned for big folders
Comics CBZ/CBR and videos straight from archives

free.note: Paid: $19.95 single user (1 year of updates), $29.95 family, $69.95 small business; 2-year update tiers $34.95/$49.95/$119.95; free trial

native_apple_silicon.note: Native on Apple silicon since 3.5 (isAppleSiliconReady); version history fixes Apple Silicon specific issues

no_account_no_tracking.note: No usage analytics; license key check and daily update check contact Binarynights; crash reports opt-in

dark_light_setting.note: Light, Dark or Default (follows macOS) theme, plus custom themes

languages_20.note: 14 languages: EN, DE, HU, FR, ES, PT, PL, UK, IT, CS, JA, ZH plus Brazilian Portuguese and Traditional Chinese (4.7.x)

thumbnail_grid.note: Icon View with icon previews; no folder preview thumbnails

recursive_search.note: Own brute-force search with 'Search in Subfolders', or Spotlight

regex_search.note: Search by name, extension, kind, tags or content; regex only in Multi-Rename

network_shares_fast.note: SMB, AFP, NFS, SFTP, cloud volumes supported; no specific claim about speed on big folders

multiple_windows.note: Tabs, workspaces and 'Open in New Window'

bookmarks.note: Favorites in the sidebar, synced via iCloud

img_modern_formats.note: Preview pane shows images via macOS (HEIC, AVIF, WebP, JPEG XL as the system supports); no dedicated viewer

img_raw.note: Preview pane / Quick Look only, using macOS system RAW support; no own RAW decoder

img_psd_exr.note: No source names PSD/OpenEXR for ForkLift's preview; searched site, manual, version history

img_svg_pdf.note: PDF preview in the Preview Pane; SVG only as macOS renders it

img_animated.note: Animated images in the preview pane not documented; searched site, manual, version history

keyboard_paging.note: Preview pane and Quick Look follow the selection while arrowing through files

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom only in the macOS Quick Look window (Space/F3, Command-Plus/Minus); no own viewer

slideshow.note: No slideshow in ForkLift's manual; whether its Quick Look window offers the macOS full-screen slideshow is not documented

slideshow_recursive.note: No slideshow feature in the manual; Quick Look only browses the selected items

auto_enhance_view.note: Manual lists no image adjustments; preview only

file_info_exif.note: Info Window/Preview Pane show metadata, video dimensions, audio info

wrong_extension_note.note: Not in the manual or the feature list

video_native.note: Preview pane plays audio and video

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Only when the third-party 'QuickLook Video' plugin is installed (4.7.1)

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Icon View shows all file types side by side

video_skim_arrows.note: Arrow keys move the selection to the next item; Quick Look arrows browse items

subtitles_embedded.note: Preview pane and Quick Look play video with the macOS player; which player controls appear is not documented. Searched ForkLift manual, version history, blog, web.

subtitles_external_files.note: Preview pane and Quick Look play video with the macOS player; which player controls appear is not documented. Searched ForkLift manual, version history, blog, web.

audio_track_choice.note: Preview pane and Quick Look play video with the macOS player; which player controls appear is not documented. Searched ForkLift manual, version history, blog, web.

playback_speed.note: Preview pane and Quick Look play video with the macOS player; which player controls appear is not documented. Searched ForkLift manual, version history, blog, web.

control_bar_movable.note: Preview pane and Quick Look play video with the macOS player; which player controls appear is not documented. Searched ForkLift manual, version history, blog, web.

playlist.note: No media playlist; preview pane plays one file at a time

saved_playlists.note: No media playlist in manual or feature list

pip.note: Preview pane and Quick Look play video with the macOS player; which player controls appear is not documented. Searched ForkLift manual, version history, blog, web.

music_mode.note: Plays audio files in the preview pane, no music mode

streaming_urls.note: Connects to servers as a file manager; no streaming player in manual or feature list

online_subtitles.note: No subtitle download in manual or feature list

video_filters_enhance.note: No video adjustments in manual or feature list

archives_as_folders.note: Browse local and remote archives as folders, with Quick Look, search and filter; supported formats not listed

comics_cbz_cbr.note: No comic reader; feature list and manual name no CBZ/CBR

archive_passwords.note: Can create password-protected ZIPs (Compress with Options > Zip with Password); opening encrypted archives not documented

split_archives.note: Archive formats are not listed anywhere; searched site, manual, version history, blog

videos_in_archives.note: Quick Look inside archives is possible; no player

move_copy.note: Copy to/Move to the other pane, drag and drop

dual_pane.note: Dual pane; F5 Copy to, F6 Move to in both shortcut sets (third-party shortcut reference)

undo_file_actions.note: Undo/Redo for file operations incl. Move to Trash and Multi-Rename

image_editing.note: Manual lists no image editing; only quick text editing in place

batch_convert.note: Multi-Rename (batch rename with regex and metadata); no batch image conversion

library_catalog.note: Finder tags only (add, edit, search, filter); no ratings or catalog database

cloud_sync.note: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, Backblaze B2 etc.; folder sync

keyboard_first.note: 'Control every operation straight from the keyboard'

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Quick Open shows commands with their shortcuts; no printable sheet from the vendor

boss_key.note: Not in manual or version history

app_sandbox.note: Sold outside the Mac App Store, needs Full Disk Access and a privileged helper tool for sync with elevated privileges (not possible in the App Sandbox)

no_network.note: Network client by design (SFTP, cloud), update and license checks

notarized_attested.note: Closed source, so no build attestation from public source; notarization mentioned in old release notes

mac_app_store.note: Not found in the Mac App Store (also sold via Setapp)
